Edgeline Planners @ IMM Mall
Advertiser: Edgeline Planners
Started: 30 Apr 2026
Can a home have 3 dogs and a Luxury Living without the mess? -
For most working couples in Singapore, the dream of a Quiet
Luxury home often feels at odds with the reality of active
pets. When designer Jay first met this couple in their River
Valley condo, the challenge was clear: how do we create a
sanctuary that respects their professional need for calm
without restricting their love for their dogs? Instead of
choosing pet-proof furniture that looked industrial, Jay
applied Material Logic. / The Wood: Vertical-slatted American
Walnut for height and rhythm. / The Layout: A low-profile
sectional that preserves the architectural flow. / The Soul:
The essence of Song Chi (松弛感)—a home that breathes. This is
the essence of Song Chi (松弛感). It is the relief of coming home
to a space that breathes. Every detail, from the soft recessed
lighting to the tactile wood grain, was chosen to quiet the
mind. With a 25-year legacy, Edgeline Planners doesn't just
renovate; we solve the friction between your lifestyle and
your four walls. Comment 'DOGS' if you want to see our
pet-friendly material cheatsheet, or 'RENO' to start your own
transformation. The Epitome of Good Design Experience our
vision of quiet luxury: 📍 Office / IMM Mall #03-132/133 📍
Showroom / 136 Tembeling Road 🌐 Explore: #EdgelinePlanners
